model_annotations.Bulgarian: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for several methods across three datasets. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, labeled as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, presented in that order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and displays values ranging from 50 to 62, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The chart presents grouped bars, with each dataset having four bars representing different methods: Dapo, Grpo, PPO+Self-reflection, and Srpo. The bars for each method are colored blue, orange, green, and light blue, respectively. For the Mathverse dataset, the shortest bar, representing Srpo, has an approximate value of 52, while the tallest bar, representing Grpo, has an approximate value of 55. For the MMLU dataset, the shortest bar, representing Srpo, has an approximate value of 55, and the tallest bar, representing Grpo, has an approximate value of 58. For the Physics dataset, the shortest bar, representing PPO+Self-reflection, has an approximate value of 57, and the tallest bar, representing Grpo, has an approximate value of 61. The bars are not sorted in any particular order beyond the order of the datasets.
